subject: Deputy hand-off + review calibration for WestGrowth Eng
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deputy hand-off + review calibration for WestGrowth Eng

Team — quick update and ask: Rohan Mehta will be starting parental leave on Monday, 2026-07-20 for ~12 weeks. He has confirmed coverage and is comfortable handing day-to-day ownership to Logan Wright while he's away.

What I'm requesting today:
- Formal approval to appoint Logan as interim manager for the WestGrowth eng team during Rohan's leave (saw this as the least disruptive option given product deadlines).
- Confirmation that we can proceed with performance-review calibration on Jul 18 (window for six direct reports).
- HR assistance to kick off the manager-change workflow (Workday) and update reporting lines + access as needed.

Attachments: handover_checklist.xlsx (detailed task list + key schedules), org_chart_v2.png (current reporting).

Context/high-level risks:
- Two ICs on that team are in promotion cycles (comments compiled in the checklist). We should avoid any perception of bias; recommend we keep Rohan in calibration input but have Logan run the sessions.
- There's a customer-facing launch on Aug 4 — Logan must be empowered to approve critical bug triage & release decisions.

Proposed next steps:
1) Marcus: confirm OK with interim assignment + any headcount/hiring notes.
2) Laura/HR: start manager-change template and confirm timeline for notification.
3) Logan/Rohan: schedule 30–45m syncs this week to go through the checklist and review each direct report's open items.
4) I will schedule calibration on Jul 18 at 2pm PT (tentative) — invite to follow if we have approvals.

Please reply with approvals or objections by EOD today so I can move HR + calendar items.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

--
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deputy hand-off + review calibration for WestGrowth Eng

Thanks Marissa — understood and documented. HR is supportive of a short-term interim assignment to Logan. I will: 
- Open the manager-change ticket this morning using manager_change_template.docx (attached) and link to Workday; expect confirmation within 48 hours.
- Create a notification draft for impacted employees once the change is processed (recommend notifying after Workday change is live).
- Loop in payroll if there are any comp/bonus impacts for the out-of-cycle manager change (I don't expect changes, but we should confirm).

Two asks for the handoff:
1) Please include Rohan's 1:1 cadence and any recurring critical meetings in the checklist (helps Logan preserve continuity).
2) If there are any soft-skills calibration notes on the promotion candidates, add them to a single doc so HR can retain the record.

I approve Logan as interim from HR's perspective — Marcus, please confirm from an org/enablement lens.

Laura Bennett
Senior People Partner
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachment: manager_change_template.docx

--
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deputy hand-off + review calibration for WestGrowth Eng

+1 from Eng Ops. Logan has been pairing with Rohan on the current sprint and is already fielding the escalation queue. I have no objections to Logan taking interim manager duties.

Note for Logan: please be sure to sync with Rohan on the outstanding performance writeups and customer commitments before Jul 20. If any promotions require additional calibration beyond Jul 18, flag that early.

– Dev

--
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deputy hand-off + review calibration for WestGrowth Eng

Marissa — good plan. Approved: Logan as interim manager for the duration of Rohan's leave. Please proceed with HR workflow and notify the team once the Workday change is complete.

A couple of items to lock down before we notify ICs: 
- Calibration rubric: please use the attached calibration_rubric.pdf during the Jul 18 session and ensure Marcus/Engineering leads + Laura attend.
- Promotions: maintain the current promotion queue but have Logan run the calibration; any promotion approvals that materially change comp should be escalated to me and Finance.
- Customer signals: authorize Logan to approve release-related decisions for the Aug 4 launch; keep Rohan as an advisor while he is on leave.

I suggest we keep this interim assignment as an operational delegation (no change to headcount). If at the end of leave we need a permanent change, we'll follow the standard transfer approval flow.

I'll wait for HR confirmation and the calendar invite for Jul 18 14:00 PT. Thanks all.

Marcus Lin
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachment: calibration_rubric.pdf
